_description: committed per-station harmonic table for the §I.5 field test (BAS Filchner-Ronne GPS collection + Rutford long record); raw 30-s files NOT committed (300 MB, open licence, re-fetchable)
_phase_convention: y = A cos(w*tt + ph) with tt = hours since 1970-01-01 00:00 (common absolute epoch across stations; BAS datenum shifted by 719529), w = 2*pi/T_hours; sig_ph_rad = sig_amp/A
